Command: Do not eat winged swarming things
Summary: Winged creeping things that swarm and walk on all fours, apart from the clean leaping kinds, are unclean and may not be eaten.
Commandment: Do not eat winged swarming things that are unclean.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The general ban covers the swarming kinds, with only the leaping locust kinds excepted. The New Testament records these food distinctions set aside (Mark 7:19; Acts 10).
Purpose: To mark Israel's table as distinct (Leviticus 11). The New Testament records the distinctions set aside: Jesus declares all foods clean (Mark 7:19) and Peter's vision confirms it (Acts 10).
